svg.title: Allocate a $55,000 Reference Startup Budget
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-capital-reference-budget; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Allocate a $55,000 Reference Startup Budget; subtitle: Four buckets across $20,000 lean, $55,000 reference, and $90,000 expanded plans.; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric bar values represent the $55,000 central/reference startup plan in USD, inside the canonical $20,000–$90,000 startup capital range. Each stage also specifies its $20,000 lean-plan and $90,000 expanded-plan allocation. These are funding alternatives, not the Conservative, Base, or Scaled annual earnings scenarios.; caption: Lean: $8,000 + $4,000 + $5,000 + $3,000 = $20,000. Reference: $22,000 + $11,000 + $14,000 + $8,000 = $55,000. Expanded: $36,000 + $18,000 + $23,000 + $13,000 = $90,000.; stages: label: Working-capital runway; value: Reference $22,000; lean $8,000; expanded $36,000; numeric value: 22000.0; detail: Hold cash for staged operating commitments and collection timing. At $5,000 monthly operating expense, the lean, reference, and expanded allocations cover 1.6, 4.4, and 7.2 months before receipts, respectively; at $25,000 they cover 0.32, 0.88, and 1.44 months. Direct delivery costs can require additional cash.; label: Contracting and risk setup; value: Reference $11,000; lean $4,000; expanded $18,000; numeric value: 11000.0; detail: Fund scoped agreement review, insurance placement, entity administration, and jurisdiction-specific operating procedures. SAM.gov registration itself is free; any paid assistance must be separately described rather than represented as a government registration charge.; label: Bid-desk systems and launch delivery; value: Reference $14,000; lean $5,000; expanded $23,000; numeric value: 14000.0; detail: Fund secure document storage, access controls, CRM setup, calendar automation, and limited launch contractor work. Use SAM.gov alerts, Microsoft 365, and documented checklists before purchasing overlapping research subscriptions.; label: Pipeline development; value: Reference $8,000; lean $3,000; expanded $13,000; numeric value: 8000.0; detail: Fund targeted supplier outreach, capability interviews, industry meetings, and scoped proposal development. Model the stated 3–12 months to first deal; startup cash alone does not support every combination of that delay and the $5,000–$25,000 monthly operating range.

rect.title: label: Working-capital runway; numeric value: 22000.0; value: Reference $22,000; lean $8,000; expanded $36,000; detail: Hold cash for staged operating commitments and collection timing. At $5,000 monthly operating expense, the lean, reference, and expanded allocations cover 1.6, 4.4, and 7.2 months before receipts, respectively; at $25,000 they cover 0.32, 0.88, and 1.44 months. Direct delivery costs can require additional cash.

label: Contracting and risk setup; numeric value: 11000.0; value: Reference $11,000; lean $4,000; expanded $18,000; detail: Fund scoped agreement review, insurance placement, entity administration, and jurisdiction-specific operating procedures. SAM.gov registration itself is free; any paid assistance must be separately described rather than represented as a government registration charge.

rect.title: label: Bid-desk systems and launch delivery; numeric value: 14000.0; value: Reference $14,000; lean $5,000; expanded $23,000; detail: Fund secure document storage, access controls, CRM setup, calendar automation, and limited launch contractor work. Use SAM.gov alerts, Microsoft 365, and documented checklists before purchasing overlapping research subscriptions.

Model the stated 3–12 months to first deal; startup cash alone does not support every combination of that delay and the $5,000–$25,000 monthly operating range.
